diff --git a/fastapi/openapi/utils.py b/fastapi/openapi/utils.py
index dbc93d28..24d5a3f0 100644
--- a/fastapi/openapi/utils.py
+++ b/fastapi/openapi/utils.py
@@ -87,7 +87,29 @@ def get_openapi_security_definitions(
             exclude_none=True,
         )
         security_name = security_requirement.security_scheme.scheme_name
-        security_definitions[security_name] = security_definition
+        if security_name in security_definitions:
+            existing_definition = security_definitions[security_name]
+            if (
+                existing_definition.get("type") == "oauth2"
+                and security_definition.get("type") == "oauth2"
+            ):
+                # Merge flows
+                existing_flows = existing_definition.get("flows", {})
+                new_flows = security_definition.get("flows", {})
+                for flow_name, flow_details in new_flows.items():
+                    if flow_name in existing_flows:
+                        # Merge scopes
+                        existing_scopes = existing_flows[flow_name].get("scopes", {})
+                        new_scopes = flow_details.get("scopes", {})
+                        existing_scopes.update(new_scopes)
+                        existing_flows[flow_name]["scopes"] = existing_scopes
+                    else:
+                        existing_flows[flow_name] = flow_details
+                security_definitions[security_name] = existing_definition
+            else:
+                security_definitions[security_name] = security_definition
+        else:
+            security_definitions[security_name] = security_definition
         operation_security.append({security_name: security_requirement.scopes})
     return security_definitions, operation_security
 
diff --git a/repro_security_scopes.py b/repro_security_scopes.py

index 00000000..f55c1534
--- /dev/null
+++ b/repro_security_scopes.py
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, Security
+from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
+from fastapi.openapi.utils import get_openapi_security_definitions
+from fastapi.routing import APIRoute
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+auth1 = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token", scopes={"me": "Read my profile"})
+auth2 = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token", scopes={"items": "Read items"})
+
+@app.get("/me")
+def read_me(token: str = Security(auth1, scopes=["me"])):
+    return {"me": "me"}
+
+@app.get("/items")
+def read_items(token: str = Security(auth2, scopes=["items"])):
+    return {"items": "items"}
+
+def test_security_definitions():
+    openapi_schema = app.openapi()
+    security_schemes = openapi_schema["components"]["securitySchemes"]
+    
+    print(f"Security Schemes: {security_schemes}")
+    
+    scheme = security_schemes["OAuth2PasswordBearer"]
+    scopes = scheme["flows"]["password"]["scopes"]
+    print(f"Scopes: {scopes}")
+    
+    assert "me" in scopes
+    assert "items" in scopes
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_security_definitions()
+        print("Test passed!")
+    except AssertionError as e:
+        print("Test failed: Scopes were not merged.")
+        raise e
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
+        raise e
